thread:
nina: uploaded canary results for rwd-v5-quant4-burnin — quick summary: p50 latency ~20% down, token cost ~35% lower, but rerank MRR on cohort A shows a ~1.8% absolute drop. attaching the sliced table and eval plots. thinking about an automatic fallback threshold — opinions? :thinking_face:
omar: can you paste the slice table inline? curious if this is concentrated on longdocs or a specific intent slice :eyes:
taylor: paste from the csv —
```
slice,queries,rr_mrr,baseline_rr_mrr,delta_abs
short-chat,12000,0.782,0.775,+0.7%
code-completion,2400,0.633,0.667,-3.4%
longdoc-summarize,1800,0.514,0.538,-2.4%
rerank-cohort-A,5000,0.712,0.730,-1.8%
```
looks like regressions concentrated on code-completion and longdoc. short-chat improved.
lee: is KV-warmup accounted for? quant4 can be brittle on long context until kv cache warms. what's the coldstart fraction in these slices?
nina: coldstart fraction for longdoc ~23%, code-completion ~8%. we ran a warmup subtest with 3 prefix tokens and saw a ~0.6% MRR recovery for longdoc but not full.
vikram: two thoughts — 1) set a tiered fallback: automatic soft-fallback if delta_abs >= 1.5% over 30m window + top-slice weight, escalate to hard rollback at 2.5% over 60m. 2) add slice-weighting to the comparator so longdocs > 1x weight when at-risk.
omar: I'm +1 on soft vs hard tiers. we should also check hallucination rate on code completions — regressions there can be amplified. do we have halluc counts?
taylor: quick numbers from the eval harness: code-completion halluc rate up from 0.9% -> 1.6% (delta +0.7pp). that's concerning.
ci-bot: smoke checks for rwd-v5-quant4-burnin: unit-tests ✅, canary-load ✅, basic-evals: WARN (rerank_mrr drop)
nina: proposed gate config snippet for autoscaling/fallback (draft):
```
{"auto_fallback": {
  "metric": "rerank_mrr",
  "delta_abs_soft": "0.015",    # soft: reduce traffic to 10% over 15m
  "window_soft_mins": "30",
  "delta_abs_hard": "0.025",    # hard: rollback to rwd-v5-int8
  "window_hard_mins": "60",
  "slice_weights": {"longdoc-summarize": "1.5", "code-completion": "2.0"}
}}
```
lee: I'd make delta_abs_soft 0.01 for code-completion specifically given halluc increase. small regressions there are high-impact.
vikram: agree. we can do per-slice overrides. also add a minimum query volume filter so noisy small slices don't trigger.
omar: ops question: if soft-fallback triggers, do we automatically reduce traffic percentage or spin up fallback instances? what do we prefer for Dedicated customers?
nina: for Dedicated we prefer traffic steering (reduce to quant4 pool -> 10%) and spin fallback pool on standby. hosted default is rollback to int8 after hard threshold.
taylor: I'll run a targeted shadow for code-completion with more samples (x5) overnight and post updated deltas in the morning. if halluc delta stays >0.5pp we'll tighten the soft threshold to 1.0% for that slice.
ci-bot: scheduled shadow job 1746506000 for sample-size x5 (code-completion)
nina: action items: 1) taylor run shadow + re-eval (due tomorrow) 2) lee add per-slice min-volume filter to gate config 3) vikram draft rollout policy text for SRE + sales (Dedicated differences). tagging @omar for final signoff on numbers before we flip the automated gate. :white_check_mark:
omar: sounds good. will review once taylor posts results. :thumbsup:
